name: automation-testing-hub
description: Arquitetura base para automação de testes E2E com Cypress (Page Object Pattern, multi-ambiente e relatórios).

scripts.cy:open:dev: cross-env ENV=dev CYPRESS_CACHE_FOLDER=./cypress-cache cypress open --browser chrome
scripts.cy:open:prod: cross-env ENV=prod CYPRESS_CACHE_FOLDER=./cypress-cache cypress open --browser chrome
scripts.cy:run:dev: cross-env ENV=dev CYPRESS_CACHE_FOLDER=./cypress-cache cypress run --browser chrome
scripts.cy:run:prod: cross-env ENV=prod CYPRESS_CACHE_FOLDER=./cypress-cache cypress run --browser chrome

author: Natan (https://github.com/Nataansl)
